sourceItems.title: 2020年6月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: June manufacturing PMI was 50.9; production 53.9 and new orders 51.4, confirming continued domestic manufacturing recovery while new export orders remained below 50.

sourceItems.title: Industrial Profits decreased 19.3 percent in the First Five Months of 2020
sourceItems.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
normalizedClaims: May industrial profits rose 6.0% YoY after falling in April; Jan-May electronics manufacturing profits rose 34.7% and special-purpose machinery rose 16.6%, while autos, metals and chemicals remained down sharply.
observedChanges: industrial profit cycle turns positive in May
electronics and special-purpose machinery show relative profit strength

sourceItems.title: Brief analysis on the economic operation of automobile industry in May 2020
normalizedClaims: May auto sales rose 14.5% YoY; commercial vehicles rose 48.0%; heavy-truck sales reached 179k, up 65.6% YoY and a May record. NEV sales were still down 23.5% YoY.
observedChanges: commercial-vehicle demand surges to record levels

sourceItems.title: Server DRAM Prices Will Not Rise as Much as Projected Earlier for 2H20 Due to Shifts in Market Dynamics
normalizedClaims: Server DRAM remained in an upcycle, but TrendForce reduced its prior 2H20 price-rise expectations as pandemic-driven supply-chain uncertainty and shifting procurement dynamics increased.
observedChanges: memory upcycle remains positive but expected duration/magnitude weakens

sourceItems.title: EnergyTrend: The Price Report of PV Industry Supply Chain (June 29)
normalizedClaims: Chinese mono and multi polysilicon prices declined again in late June while wafer prices were broadly stable, indicating that upstream scarcity/pricing power had not yet emerged.
observedChanges: no confirmed upstream scarcity by quarter-end

sourceItems.title: Gold shines as coronavirus surge unnerves investors
normalizedClaims: Gold reached its highest level in nearly eight years as renewed coronavirus concerns increased safe-haven demand, showing a strong monetary/defensive regime but also substantial prior price appreciation.

sourceItems.title: Iron ore volatile as Brazil supply worries ease, but China demand hopes offer support
normalizedClaims: Iron ore remained supported around elevated levels by resilient Chinese demand even as Brazilian supply concerns eased.

eventClusters.statement: China commercial-vehicle demand rebounded far faster than passenger vehicles, with May heavy-truck and light-truck sales reaching record levels.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The surge may partly reflect deferred demand, infrastructure stimulus and emissions-policy replacement. Deep research must test duration and company-level profit conversion.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share truck/value-chain expressions had direct volume-to-profit conversion and reasonable expectation burden by late Q2?

eventClusters.statement: Industrial profits turned positive year on year in May, with electronics and special-purpose machinery already showing strong cumulative profit growth despite broad-economy weakness.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Sector aggregates are too broad for direct stock selection. Deep research must identify specific operating variables and avoid equating category strength with every listed company.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are there narrow listed expressions where the observed profit resilience is tied to a measurable company engine rather than broad beta?

eventClusters.statement: Server DRAM remained in a positive pricing cycle, but by late May the expected 2H20 price upside was being revised down as procurement and supply-chain dynamics weakened.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The physical cycle is still positive, so the key test is whether the market already capitalized it and whether the next-period path is weakening.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should memory-related expressions remain actionable, or has the known Q2 strength already become a duration/expectation trap?

eventClusters.statement: Late-Q2 PV upstream prices remained weak, with polysilicon still declining and no confirmed scarcity signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Structural solar demand may still be attractive, but the quarter-end physical pricing signal does not support an upstream scarcity thesis.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should PV remain research-only until demand/pricing inflects, and are any company-specific engines strong enough to override weak upstream pricing?

eventClusters.statement: Gold reached a near eight-year high as pandemic risk and safe-haven demand intensified, creating strong miner cash-flow leverage but also rising expectation-absorption risk.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Deep research must distinguish still-underreflected earnings leverage from simply chasing a commodity already near a multi-year high.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share gold producer still offer acceptable normalized earnings-path room after the Q2 rerating?

eventClusters.statement: China infrastructure/construction demand supported iron ore and steel activity even as broader manufacturing and external demand remained uneven.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Strength may be stimulus-driven and concentrated in construction. Deep research must avoid extrapolating it to all industrial cyclicals.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed expressions, if any, had direct earnings exposure to the infrastructure demand impulse without excessive cycle/valuation risk?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing production and new orders remained in expansion by June, while export orders were still weak.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Use as context and timing evidence only; too broad for direct stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Context only; do not map directly to a stock.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff heavy-truck price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Truck basket 20d excess +6.11pp and 60d +19.03pp; breadth 50%/50%; favorable. 中国重汽 itself was +15.29pp 20d and +39.24pp 60d excess, while 潍柴动力 slightly lagged the benchmark.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff construction-machinery price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Construction basket 20d excess -6.22pp and 60d -7.28pp; breadth 0%/0%; adverse despite improving industry expectations.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff gold-equity price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Gold basket 20d excess -1.73pp and 60d -2.30pp; breadth 50%/50%; neutral. 山东黄金 underperformed CSI300 over both lookbacks while 紫金 modestly outperformed.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff electronics price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Electronics basket 20d excess +8.27pp and 60d +15.96pp; breadth 100%/100%; favorable. Both 兆易创新 and 韦尔股份 had already materially outperformed.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff PV price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: PV basket 20d excess +18.26pp and 60d +43.94pp; breadth 100%/100%; favorable. 通威 and 隆基 had already sharply rerated while polysilicon pricing remained weak.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中国重汽2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB8.21bn -28.76% YoY, attributable profit RMB263m -15.46%, but operating cash flow turned to +RMB770m from -RMB236m. Q1 predates the record May heavy-truck boom.

evidenceDocuments.title: 潍柴动力2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue RMB39.0bn -13.74%, attributable profit RMB2.06bn -20.34%, operating cash flow -RMB9.50bn. Direct truck/powertrain exposure exists but Q1 company conversion was weaker than the later industry boom.

evidenceDocuments.title: 汽车行业周报：新版双积分政策落地，助力节能与新能源汽车产业发展
normalizedClaims: Heavy-truck beneficiaries were 中国重汽 and 潍柴动力. At June 24 prices, 2020E/2021E EPS for 中国重汽 were 2.16/2.32 with PE 13.33x/12.37x; 潍柴动力 EPS 1.24/1.35 with PE 10.94x/10.04x.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue -18.92%, attributable profit -31.90% and operating cash flow negative, so the post-lockdown machinery recovery had not yet entered reported company earnings.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中联重科2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +0.55%, attributable profit +2.39%,扣非 +6.06%; operating cash flow remained positive but fell sharply year on year.

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工：上调EPS，四个维度深入解读当前投资价值
normalizedClaims: Forecast 2020/21/22 profit RMB14.429/16.621/17.659bn, +28.8%/+15.2%/+6.2%, at PE about 10.87x/9.44x/8.89x; thesis emphasized extended replacement demand, share gains and operating leverage.

evidenceDocuments.title: 机械设备行业2020年下半年投资策略：踏准周期，把握成长
normalizedClaims: At June 23 prices, 中联重科 2020E/21E EPS 0.72/0.84 and PE 8.71x/7.46x; 三一 1.60/1.75 and PE 11.52x/10.53x, showing low point valuation despite the adverse relative-price regime.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山东黄金2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +28.70%, attributable profit +57.94%,扣非 +59.03% and operating cash flow +1.30%, directly confirming gold-price-to-profit conversion.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山东黄金全资收购TMAC，持续稳固黄金龙头地位
normalizedClaims: Forecast 2020/21/22 profit RMB1.667/2.152/2.418bn, EPS 0.54/0.69/0.78 and PE about 68.1x/52.8x/47.0x; report argued Q1 strength made 2020 forecast conservative but valuation burden was already high.

evidenceDocuments.title: 兆易创新2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +76.51%, attributable profit +323.24%,扣非 +369.14%, while operating cash flow was negative. Strong company growth was real but not equivalent to direct server-DRAM exposure.

evidenceDocuments.title: 韦尔股份2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +44.21%, attributable profit +800.03%,扣非 +1530.8%; another direct electronics growth control with very strong realized earnings.

evidenceDocuments.title: 电子行业周报重点公司盈利预测
normalizedClaims: At late-June prices, 兆易创新 2020E/21E EPS 2.25/2.99 with PE about 109x/82x; 韦尔股份 2020E/21E EPS 2.62/3.67 with PE about 79x/56x. Strong growth already carried high duration expectations.

evidenceDocuments.title: 存储器价格迎上升周期，本土企业获得良机
normalizedClaims: Before Q2, the market narrative already expected a 2020 memory price upcycle and highlighted 兆易创新, with 2020E PE around 92x. The later May downgrade of server-DRAM price expectations therefore matters for expectation duration.

evidenceDocuments.title: 通威股份2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +26.85% but attributable profit -29.79% and扣非 -33.39%; weak upstream pricing had not converted into stronger profit for this upstream-integrated expression.

evidenceDocuments.title: 隆基股份2020年第一季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue +50.60%, attributable profit +204.92%,扣非 +195.39%, while operating cash flow was negative. The company engine was very strong despite weak upstream polysilicon pricing.
